comparison: Two actual paired initial families times four complete policies per eight-lane wave. Each DP always paired with its own refreshed trained Transformer.
selection: Select one complete shared-data snapshot (76 or72) for BOTH roles. Primary: summed native full-task successes over the16 role-trials in the8 paired families. Ties: summed hold120 diagnostic, then number of native-subgoal-reaching role-trials; still tied retain source72. Report individual A/B outcomes and any front-stage loss; no pooled count substitutes for per-role reporting. Holding is a tie-break, never task success.
checkpoint_freeze: Normal validation-selected complete pair after each registered training budget closes. Pair hashes frozen by existing prepare_development before any comparison rollout.
remaining_scope: No further collection iterations or parameter updates after round06. No changes based on held-out test. Twenty preregistered new test families stay unopened until final pair freeze.

selection_amendment_before_training_comp.prior_selection: Per role: higher native full-task successes first; if tied prefer higher hold120 diagnostic, then more native subgoal-reaching trials; if still tied retain source72. Holding is only a tie-break diagnostic, not a task-success definition. Report any front-stage loss even when insertion count increases.
selection_amendment_before_training_comp.reason: Keep final A/B on one common training-data snapshot instead of selecting different data counts per role.
